description: This file contains the implementation of complex number calculations in a spreadsheet context, including conversion between real and imaginary parts, and extracting imaginary and real coefficients from complex numbers.

classes.name: Complex
classes.description: Provides methods for handling complex number calculations such as converting real and imaginary parts into a complex number and extracting parts from complex numbers.

methods.name: COMPLEX
methods.description: Converts real and imaginary coefficients into a complex number string, with optional suffix, or evaluates array inputs accordingly.

methods.name: IMAGINARY
methods.description: Returns the imaginary part of a complex number.

methods.name: IMREAL
methods.description: Returns the real part of a complex number.
